name: 13199-solodecode-qwen3vl30ba3b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking, ungated, served in its native bf16 with no quantization_config.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- 57.9 GiB of weights fits one 80 GB card.
architecture: Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration: 48 decoder layers, hidden 2048, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128 (96 KiB of KV per token), 128 routed experts top-8 so ~3B of ~30.5B parameters are active, bf16, 57.9 GiB over 13 shards, plus a vision tower this text-only workload never enters.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 and pinned there rather than a starting value, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 96 requests with a 2700 s safety cap (72 measured requests, ~36k decode intervals).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, TEXT ONLY, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Fixed 512-token prompts and fixed 512-token generations (no stdev), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true so every request decodes exactly its 512 steps.
purpose: A reasoning assistant answering single-turn 512-token prompts with 512-token replies, one user at a time, on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang launch declaration: one H100 serving a 30B sparse-MoE vision-language model in
# bf16 at TP1, one request in flight, 512 tokens in and 512 out.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested line is SKIPPED by the reader, and the
# engine would then start without something this file declares. host / port /
# served-model-name are set by whatever starts the server and must not be written here.

# 57.9 GiB over 13 safetensors shards; not cached on this machine, downloads once.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking

tp-size: 1

# The capture list at 64 includes 1, and this workload runs at a batch of 1.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64

disable-radix-cache: true

# The checkpoint declares 262144 max positions; the request-to-token pool is sized by
# this and the workload never exceeds ~1024 tokens.
context-length: 32768

# Pinned so the KV pool is a declared quantity rather than a property of the card:
# 0.85 x 79.6 GiB = 67.7 GiB static, less 57.9 GiB of weights, leaves ~9.8 GiB of pool.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
